concepts.name: Cue
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a premium original brand concept board for a personal video website named exactly "Cue". The site improves YouTube with organised subscriptions, a smooth recommendation feed and a better player. The user wants the logo visibly connected to video playback and queues, with absolutely no animals, birds, mascots or unrelated nature imagery.
Design direction: compact, unmistakably digital, editorial and confident. An original geometric symbol that combines a clean C / Q-like cue loop with a small forward-play cutout and an offset queue stroke. Strong solid silhouette, expressive negative space, impeccably balanced geometry, memorable at favicon size. Do not simply draw a YouTube-style rounded rectangle with a triangle. No stock icons.
Beautiful custom wordmark "Cue", expertly kerned rounded geometric sans, cream white, with one small bespoke letter detail that echoes the mark.
Colours: vivid soft coral #FF765E, warm white #F8F3EE, deep charcoal #111316. Flat vector-style forms, smooth crisp contours, no gradients, no paper texture, no lighting, no dimensional effects.
Layout: landscape 1536x1024 identity board, restrained professional editorial grid. Upper 70% deep charcoal, generous negative space, one large centered horizontal logo and wordmark. Small understated line below reads exactly "Your next great watch.". Lower 30% warm white with three evenly spaced consistent versions of the identical identity: coral symbol alone; all-black horizontal symbol and wordmark; small dark app-icon tile with coral symbol. Same mark in all versions. Clearly video-product identity. No other text. No decorative patterns or mockup objects. A refined, original, professionally executed brand, not a generic startup template.

concepts.name: Playdeck
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished original brand identity concept board for a personal YouTube companion website with exact name "Playdeck". The name means your own deck of videos and channels, arranged for effortless watching. Product purpose should be immediately evident from the icon. Absolutely no animals, birds, mascots, planetary symbols or unrelated metaphors.
Design direction: a beautiful original compact symbol made from two offset video cards, with one confident forward-play shape elegantly integrated into the front card's negative space. Use cropped corners or a subtle stepped edge to suggest an organised queue and make the mark distinctive. It must be simple, clear at 24px and recognisable as video plus organisation. Avoid copying the YouTube rounded rectangle, avoid a generic document-stack icon or clipart.
Pair with bespoke typography for exact wordmark "Playdeck", highly legible, strong contemporary grotesk, carefully kerned, slightly condensed but welcoming, one restrained custom letterform detail.
Colours: amber #FFB020, warm white #F7F4EC and midnight #0D1117, connecting to the website's existing dark UI. Strictly flat vector-style artwork, smooth crisp contours, no gradients, no texture, no shadows or 3D.
Landscape board 1536x1024. Upper 70% midnight background, large dominant centered horizontal symbol + wordmark with generous negative space. Small understated tagline exactly "Your videos. Better arranged.". Lower 30% warm white, three elegant evenly spaced applications: amber symbol alone; monochrome black horizontal lockup; small rounded-square dark favicon/app tile with amber symbol. Repeat the identical mark and typography consistently throughout. No extra text, no decoration or illustrative mockups. High-end independent design-studio quality and optical balance.

concepts.name: Frame
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create an exceptional original identity board for a personal video watching website named exactly "Frame". This is a refined alternative interface for YouTube, designed around a better player, channel subscriptions and effortless browsing. The logo must clearly evoke video framing / a viewing window. Absolutely no animals, birds, mascots, planets or decorative nature imagery.
Design direction: a highly distinctive open rectangular frame, made from two or three precisely cut corner elements, with subtle negative space suggesting a capital F and a rightward viewing direction. Clever but instantly readable, precise geometry, a strong silhouette that remains legible at 24px. The frame should be compact and iconic, not four generic camera-focus brackets. Avoid a typical YouTube play button, generic gradients or a TV-with-antenna icon.
Wordmark exact spelling "Frame", expertly kerned elegant medium-bold geometric sans, slightly technical and premium but approachable, custom F or a detail matching the logo's cuts.
Colours: clear sky blue #78B7FF, cool white #F4F7FC and deep navy-black #0B111B. Strictly flat vector-style colours, crisp smooth contours, no texture, no gradients, no depth or lighting effects.
Layout: a landscape identity board 1536x1024, carefully balanced editorial grid and generous whitespace. Upper 70% deep navy-black, one large dominant centered horizontal icon + wordmark, small understated tagline exactly "A clearer way to watch.". Lower 30% cool white with three evenly spaced faithful uses of the same identity: blue symbol alone; monochrome black horizontal logo; small dark rounded-square favicon tile with blue symbol. No extra text, patterns or stock mockup objects. Sophisticated, memorable, professionally finished digital product identity.
